channel.title: Chemical Reviews
channel.description: Critical reviews of the chemical literature, by Benedict D. Ticehurst.

item.title: Building and Comparing Models for Melting Point Prediction of Organic Compounds
item.description: A comparative evaluation of four modelling strategies, PCA-based and full-descriptor linear regression, LASSO regression, and descriptor- and Morgan-fingerprint-based neural networks, for predicting the melting points of organic compounds from molecular structure.

item.title: Wood-Derived Electrodes: A Solution for Low Tortuosity Electrodes
item.description: A critical review of conventional battery and supercapacitor electrodes, and of wood-templated, magnetically-templated, and 3D-printed strategies for producing low-tortuosity, sustainable energy-storage electrodes.
